title: Machine-learning-assisted materials discovery using failed experiments
study_design: retrospective notebook corpus plus prospective experiments
key_result: 3955 complete reactions including failures were used to guide prospective synthesis
limitation: single reaction family and non-open notebook source; does not establish cross-domain prevalence

title: Target prediction utilising negative bioactivity data covering large chemical space
claim_supported: negative bioactivity data already exist and have been used
key_result: presumed inactive records were incorporated into target-prediction models
limitation: negatives were presumed and sampled; not recovered from literature with full context

title: Benchmarking compound activity prediction for real-world drug discovery applications
key_result: sparsity heterogeneity and assay-dependent measurement distributions materially affect evaluation
limitation: does not measure missing negative literature evidence

title: InertDB as a generative AI-expanded resource of biologically inactive small molecules from PubChem
claim_supported: a closely overlapping negative-data resource already exists
study_design: curation of 3205 inactive compounds plus generative expansion
key_result: resource reports 64368 generated inactive compounds and downstream comparisons
limitation: generated compounds are not observed negatives; scope is biological inactivity

title: ECBD: European chemical biology database
claim_supported: complete screening pipelines can preserve positive and negative outcomes
key_result: stores primary and counter-screening results including negative activity data
limitation: infrastructure-specific and not a retrospective literature recovery system

title: Coverage bias in small molecule machine learning
study_design: coverage analysis across common small-molecule datasets
key_result: reports non-uniform coverage of known molecular structure space
limitation: coverage bias is not direct evidence of missing negative outcomes

title: Hidden bias in the DUD-E dataset leads to misleading performance of deep learning in structure-based virtual screening
study_design: structure-based and ligand-only controls on DUD-E
key_result: high apparent performance can be explained by analogue and decoy bias
limitation: addresses benchmark construction rather than publication or reporting bias

title: A preclinical secondary pharmacology resource illuminates target-adverse drug reaction associations of marketed drugs
claim_supported: inactive results are less represented than active results in commonly used curated/subscription activity resources
study_design: Systematic profiling of 1,958 marketed drugs across 200 assays; cross-reference 121,097 SPD drug-assay summaries against ChEMBL, DrugCentral and subscription sources
key_result: Authors report ~95% SPD results unique to compared sources; active SPD AC50<1 uM results ~36% unique, and inactive results have the highest uniqueness. Local approximate check: 94.81% overall and 37.60% of AC50<1 uM results are unique under an operational field rule
limitation: SPD uniqueness means absent from selected comparator resources, not necessarily unpublished; protocol/assay and resource coverage differences can contribute. Local computation is a sanity check, not exact paper reproduction

title: SPD supplementary-data coverage recomputation (audit of Sutherland et al. 2023)
domain: molecular bioactivity resource coverage / reproducibility audit
claim_supported: Public supplementary data reproduce the ~36% unique high-activity result but do not yet reproduce the reported ~95% overall uniqueness using straightforward source-field definitions
study_design: 121,097 rows in Zenodo Supplementary_Data.xlsx, S Data 1; cross-resource median AC50, single-concentration and representative-pair fields
key_result: Row-level recomputation: 36.40% unique for AC50<1 uM with three median fields and 36.07% including single-concentration fields; 92.85% and 92.53% overall, respectively; 95.40% of AC50>=10 uM rows have no median AC50 in the three compared resources
limitation: Operational missing-field criterion; unresolved denominator, representative-pair and matching rules. Resource noncoverage is not proof that a result was unpublished
